housing: Sevenoaks is one of the most expensive districts in Kent, with large detached houses around Sevenoaks town, period cottages in villages such as Otford, Shoreham and Westerham, and post-war estates in Swanley. Most of the district is Green Belt and the Kent Downs, so new building is limited. Fewer households rent privately than the national average; lets are mostly family houses and flats near the stations on the lines into London. Social housing is concentrated in Swanley and parts of Sevenoaks town.
checkinTips: Period cottages in villages such as Otford, Shoreham and Westerham: photograph beams, low ceilings, chimney breasts and any damp on solid walls.
Large detached houses: record the garden, hedges, gates, garages and any outbuildings, and agree what upkeep the tenant is expected to do.
Rural homes off the gas grid: photograph the oil tank and gauge level, or the LPG tank, and any septic tank or treatment plant cover.
Flats near Sevenoaks and Swanley stations: note fob, key and parking permit counts and the bin store arrangements.
Homes with wood burners or open fires: photograph the stove glass, hearth and any sweep certificate left for the tenant.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems can contact Sevenoaks District Council's Private Sector Housing team, which can inspect homes and take action against landlords.
